manifest.name: code
manifest.title: Code
manifest.description: Inline code in running text (a SQLSTATE, an identifier, a digest) as a <code> in text.code-sm; long values break anywhere.
manifest.usage: Use Code inside a sentence for something the user might type or copy: a SQLSTATE, a table name, a digest or a fingerprint. variant="plain" drops the background inside dense places. For several lines use CodeBlock; for keyboard keys use Kbd; for an editable value use CodeInput.

props.name: variant
props.description: default on color.bg.inset; plain without a background.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: a <samp> for output, a <var> for a placeholder.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

accessibility: A <code> element read in place with the sentence; render <samp> for program output, which is semantically different.
color.fg.default on color.bg.inset is contrast-checked as text.
Long unbroken values break anywhere (break-all) so they never force horizontal scrolling.
Not focusable; to make it copyable, put a copy IconButton next to it.
